policies.name: AppEngine - Admin
policies.description: Grants admin permissions to view, run, and install Dynatrace Apps, and view workflows.

policies.name: AppEngine - Manage EdgeConnect
policies.description: Grants full access to manage EdgeConnect.

policies.name: Email Service - allow to send email
policies.description: Grants permission to send emails from `@apps.dynatrace.com` using a public send email API endpoint.

policies.name: Settings Writer
policies.description: Grants permission to read and write Dynatrace settings.

policies.name: Storage All System Data Read
policies.description: Grants unconditional access to all Grail system tables prefixed with "dt.".

policies.name: Read BizEvents
policies.description: Grants unconditional access to the bizevents table and to all bizevent buckets, including all custom bizevent buckets.

policies.name: AutomationEngine - User access
policies.description: Grants basic read access to workflows.

policies.name: Extensions - Admin access
policies.description: Grants access to view, add, activate, update, and delete all the extensions and their monitoring configurations.

policies.name: Hub Catalog Read
policies.description: Grants read access to the Hub catalog content.

policies.name: Ingest Events write
policies.description: Grants permission to write events to the ingest endpoints.

policies.name: Settings Reader
policies.description: Grants read access to Dynatrace settings.

policies.name: Read Application Snapshots
policies.description: Grants read access to the Grail application snapshots table.

policies.name: Read Entities
policies.description: Grants read access to all entities.

policies.name: Read Events
policies.description: Grants unconditional access to the Grail events table and to all event buckets (excluding security events).

policies.name: Read Logs
policies.description: Grants unconditional access to the logs table and all log buckets, including all custom log buckets.

policies.name: Storage Metrics Write
policies.description: Grants permission to write metrics to Grail.

policies.name: Read System Events
policies.description: Grants read access to all Dynatrace system events data.

policies.name: Read Sensitive Data
policies.description: Grants unconditional permissions to read sensitive data in Dynatrace.

policies.name: Read Security Events
policies.description: Grants unconditional access to the security events from both, `events` and `security.events` tables and to the default security event buckets.

policies.name: Data-Acquisition AWS Integration
policies.description: Grants permissions to configure and ingest AWS data through Data-Acquisition APIs.

policies.name: Read User Replays
policies.description: Grants read access to all user replay data

policies.name: Azure Native Dynatrace Service Integration
policies.description: Grants permissions to configure and manage Azure native features for ANDS, including logs ingest and installation of Azure extensions for Virtual Machines, App Services, ARC Machine, and Azure Kubernetes Services.

policies.name: Read Spans
policies.description: Grants unconditional access to the spans table and all spans buckets, including all custom spans buckets.

policies.name: Storage Default Monitoring Read
policies.description: Grants unconditional access to all the Grail tables and default buckets (excluding security events).

policies.name: OpenPipeline Ingest
policies.description: Grants permission to ingest data into OpenPipeline.

policies.name: Kubernetes Ingest
policies.description: Grants permissions for Kubernetes ingest

policies.name: Kubernetes Onboarding
policies.description: Grants permissions for Kubernetes onboarding

policies.name: Kubernetes Operator
policies.description: Grants permissions for Kubernetes operator

policies.name: Hyperscaler authentication service
policies.description: Grants permissions to authenticate against hyperscalers.

policies.name: Data-Acquisition GCP Integration
policies.description: Grants permissions to configure and ingest GCP data through Data-Acquisition APIs.

policies.name: Data-Acquisition AWS Integration App
policies.description: Grants permissions to users who will manage (create/modify/delete) AWS connections in the fleet managment app.

policies.name: Data-Acquisition Cloud Integrations All
policies.description: Grants permissions to users who will manage (create/modify/delete) cloud connections in the Fleet Management app. Use policy boundaries to restrict to a particular hyperscaler if needed.

policies.name: DtWiz Ingestion User
policies.description: Grants permissions to users or service users who should be able to ingest data using dtwiz

policies.name: Environment role - Configure capture of sensitive data

policies.name: Environment role - Manage security problems

policies.name: Environment role - Replay session data
policies.description: Permission to access 'Replay Sessions With Masking' features (equivalence RBAC permission).

policies.name: Environment role - View security problems
policies.description: Permission to access 'View Security Problems' features (equivalence RBAC permission).

policies.name: Read Smartscape
